title: Taskflow Agent finds cross-thread edit authorization flaw in Signal iOS
summary: Signal iOS versions from 6.28 allowed a removed group member to modify a previously sent group message on a recipient device because edit-message target lookup was not scoped to the routed thread.
ai_role: GHSL credits its Taskflow Agent and verification by Jaroslav Lobačevski. Signal reported a collision with another report on 2026-04-15 and released a fix as version 8.7.0.1523 the same day; the advisory does not establish that the AI report was first. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: The advisory says the effect is limited to the targeted recipient’s local group view; it does not claim in-the-wild exploitation.
remediation_note: Signal released the fix in 8.7.0.1523 on 2026-04-15. A collision with another report was recorded; no CVE is stated.

impacts.conditions: A removed group member can omit group context and target a prior message; cross-thread edit authorization is bypassed.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
